topic: how much Google pays to be the default search engine on phones and browsers
storyAngle: Google pays a fortune to be the first thing you search with, and one witness revealed how big a cut Apple gets.
doNotClaim: Both figures come from testimony at the US v. Google antitrust trial in fall 2023, as reported by news outlets; always say so ("testimony at the antitrust trial").
Do NOT state a total dollar amount paid to Apple; only estimates exist.
The 36% is a share of search ad revenue from Safari per Google's own expert witness, not of Apple's total revenue.
Google argued at trial that the payments reflect competition; do not accuse Google of wrongdoing.

facts.claim: Testimony at the antitrust trial said Google paid about $26.3 billion in 2021 to be the default search engine on phones and browsers.
say: twenty six point three billion dollars
facts.note: multiple outlets report the same testimony

facts.claim: Google's own expert witness said under cross-examination that Google gives Apple 36% of search ad revenue from Safari.
say: about thirty six cents on the dollar
